description: Analysis of src/services/memory_manager_actor.cr (498 lines, largest project source file). The file consolidates four unrelated responsibilities (memory monitoring, GC coordination, cleanup coordination, heap-dump diagnostics) and contains reliability defects in the memory metric itself. Highly relevant to in-progress P0 quickhea-alz (9GB VIRT leak): the 'RSS' metric that drives backpressure is actually GC heap size. Mermaid: graph LR; A[RSS metric fix] --> B[wire thresholds]; D[extract HeapDumper] --> C[harden dump_heap]
title: memory_manager_actor.cr readability and reliability refactor
